Title: The Pragmatic Programmer
Author: David Thomas, Andrew Hunt
Notes:
## Key takeaways

The "broken windows" theory applies to code: don't leave bad designs or wrong decisions in place. Fix them as soon as you see them.

## Favourite quotes

> "You Can't Write Perfect Software. Did that hurt? It shouldn't. Accept it as an axiom of life."

Great companion to reading actual code in projects you admire.

Title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
Author: Daniel Kahneman
Notes: About halfway through. The distinction between System 1 and System 2 thinking is immediately useful for spotting your own cognitive biases in everyday decisions.
